page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m2.large is a burstable instance type based on the x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and standard CPU processing.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance is positioned in the lower tier of compute capabilities. The stress-ng single-core CPU score is 1300.19, and the multi-core score is 2402.69, both falling into the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 186.46 GB/sec, but this drops significantly to 20.68 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, which is in the bottom 10%. Geekbench scores further confirm this profile, with a single-core score of 1045.0 and a multi-core score of 1850.0. Database operations, such as Redis SET operations, achieve 2.57 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput is measured at 2.44 GB/sec.

Given its burstable CPU allocation and modest resource footprint, the ecs.t6-c1m2.large offers a highly cost-efficient profile for workloads with variable or low CPU utilization. The burstable model allows users to pay a lower baseline rate while retaining the ability to handle occasional spikes in demand. This makes the instance suitable for low-traffic web servers, development and testing environments, code repositories, and lightweight microservices that do not require sustained high-performance compute or high memory bandwidth.
